bio.text: Adam Smith was born on June 15, 1965, in Washington, D.C., and was raised in SeaTac, Washington.
He graduated from Fordham University in 1987 with a degree in political science and earned his law degree from the University of Washington School of Law in 1990.
He was elected to the Washington State Senate in 1990 at age 25 and chaired its Law and Justice Committee from 1993 to 1997, and he worked as a Seattle city prosecutor from 1993 to 1995.
